name: Prismari Charm
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Surveil 2, then draw a card.
• Prismari Charm deals 1 damage to each of one or two targets.
• Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
blocked_sentences: • Prismari Charm deals 1 damage to each of one or two targets.

needs.what: a mode-owned target spec (target `mode` on a spell whose effect tree is one top-level choose_mode) whose size the caster picks -- `kind: "any", count: 2, up_to: true` owned by mode 1 -- so "deals 1 damage to each of one or two targets" declares 1 or 2 any-targets only when that bullet is chosen, beside the other modes' fixed targets
needs.why_existing_wont_do: loader.targets._check_mode_targets refuses a mode-owned spec that is variable_size (up_to) or optional, because filter_legal slices stored refs by position; a card-level up_to target would be declared for every mode, a nested choose_mode is answered on resolution with no way to declare targets, and splitting the bullet into two modes (one target / two targets) changes the printed mode list
